subject: Billing delivery & payment collection — gateway and contact for Contour Health
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Billing delivery & payment collection — gateway and contact for Contour Health

Hi Maya / AP team,

Thanks again for the productive onboarding call earlier. One quick operational question to lock down before we flip on billing: what is Contour Health's preferred invoice delivery method once production invoices start? Options we can support today: (1) Redwood Billing Portal (recommended, single-sign-on + invoice history), (2) daily invoice copies via email to AP, or (3) SFTP drop (we can evaluate but not part of our standard GA offering).

A few things we'll need to finalize to set up the chosen path:
- Billing contact (name, email, phone)
- VAT / tax ID for invoice header (if different per entity)
- Preferred payment method for US entity (ACH or Wire) and remit details if ACH

If you prefer the portal, we can provision access this week and keep email copies for a 30-day overlap. If you'd rather stay on email for now, we can mirror to the portal later.

I've cc'd Kimberly (billing ops) to coordinate the portal flow.

Next step: can you confirm preference and share the billing contact + VAT ID?

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Rishi,

Thanks — would prefer the Redwood Billing Portal as primary. We want our AP team to have direct access (searchable invoices, line-level breakdowns). For the first month can you also send PDF copies to ap@contourhealth.com so our payments team has an email record? After 30 days we can switch to portal-only if everything looks right.

Billing contact:
- Name: Tom Reyes
- Email: ap@contourhealth.com
- Phone: +1 415-555-0199

VAT/tax: Contour Health (US) NA — but our UK entity will need VAT capture later (we'll provide the VAT certificate once legal confirms).

Payment method: ACH preferred for US payments; will share ACH remit details after I loop in treasury (they want a short authorization form).

If you need a signed authorizing document for billing contact or portal access, we can do a DocuSign.

Best,
Maya
Director, Finance Operations
Contour Health

Hi Maya — great, portal + 30-day email copies is straightforward. A couple operational notes and what we'll attach to this thread:

1) Portal provisioning: we can add Tom (ap@contourhealth.com) as a primary billing user. For SSO we support OIDC; if you want SSO we'll need an IdP metadata or a test account. Otherwise we'll create a password-protected account and email credentials.

2) Invoice payloads: we attach a sample invoice XML schema we use for automated ingestion (contour_invoice_template.xml). If your AP system prefers a CSV or different XML namespace, let us know and we can map it.

3) VAT/tax capture: for now we'll mark the US entity as non-VAT. When you provide the UK VAT certificate we will tag invoices produced for that entity with the VAT ID and include the certificate PDF in the invoice metadata.

4) Payment collection: ACH is supported. We require a short remit authorization (we can send a DocuSign to the billing contact). Please note wire instructions are accepted but carry a $25 wire-processing advisory on our statements.

Attachments: contour_invoice_template.xml, payment_terms_summary.pdf

Action items:
- Maya: confirm whether you want SSO (IdP) or local portal account
- Maya/AP: provide ACH remit details (tom/ap) via secure form or DocuSign
- Connor: please schedule provisioning and keep email replication for 30 days

Thanks — I can run portal provisioning as soon as we hear on SSO vs local account.

Kimberly Park
Billing Ops Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>

Hi Maya / Tom — looping in the operations runbook. Quick timeline and next steps from our side:

- Today: Kimberly to confirm account type (SSO vs local).
- 48 hours: I will provision the portal user and enable invoice push for production (we will toggle "email copies" flag so ap@contourhealth.com receives PDFs for 30 days).
- 3 business days: invoice history backfill (monthly statements for the prior 90 days) will be made available in the portal.

DocuSign: we've prepared a one-page billing contact authorization to collect ACH remit details securely. Link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/CH-Billing-Auth-2026

Security note: if you need invoices encrypted-at-rest on our side for AP transfer, we can enable per-entity AES-256 keys; standard retention is 7 years unless you request alternate retention via your Contracts rep.

Please confirm SSO preference and whether Tom will sign the DocuSign for remit. I'll mark the provisioning ticket P1 and send calendar invites for a short walkthrough once the account is ready.

Thanks,
Connor Obrien
Revenue Ops — Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
